spec_says: spec:57 "CPOL_b, CPHA_b | The values of `i_cpol` and `i_cpha` captured at the first acceptance edge of the current burst."; spec:207 [REQ-MODE-001] capture at the acceptance edge of the first command of a burst; spec:209 [REQ-MODE-002] "CPOL_b and CPHA_b shall control `o_sclk`, `o_mosi` ... for the whole burst"; spec:211 [REQ-MODE-003] "Changes of `i_cpol` or `i_cpha` while `o_cs_n` = 0 shall have no effect on `o_sclk`, `o_mosi`..."; spec:260 "With CPHA_b = 1, `o_mosi` keeps its previous value from the acceptance edge until SCLK edge 1."; spec:400 [REQ-ERR-001] a mode change while o_cs_n=0 is "an environment violation", and the master "shall keep using CPOL_b and CPHA_b until the end of the burst"; spec:97 i_cpha "May change only while `o_cs_n` = 1"; spec:448 [ENV-003] "The environment shall change `i_cpol` and `i_cpha` only while `o_cs_n` = 1." contract.json:1071 (assumption) "if o_cs_n=1 in that cycle it is a burst start and CPOL_b=i_cpol, CPHA_b=i_cpha are captured from the same cycle". contract.json:349 (CHK-011 behavior) is written in terms of CPHA_b.
verification_does: verif/sva/nnc_chk_mosi.sv:50-55 reloads ph_r <= i_cpha on every handshake hs (line 40: hs = i_cmd_valid && o_cmd_ready), including continuation handshakes while o_cs_n=0. Line 87 then applies the CPHA_b=0 expectation exp0 = d_r[7-j0] (lines 67, 69) to a transfer whose real CPHA_b is 1.
what_to_change: (1) B fix in the checker: in nnc_chk_mosi.sv:50-55, load ph_r <= i_cpha only when hs && o_cs_n (burst start). On a continuation or Pause handshake, keep ph_r. d_r, cnt and mp_r stay per-handshake. This matches spec:57 and contract.json:1071, and it still lets formal prove REQ-MODE-003/REQ-ERR-001. (2) E fix in the environment: add ENV-003 to nnc_env.sv, e.g. once past-valid and i_rst_n=1, if (!o_cs_n) assume(i_cpol==$past(i_cpol) && i_cpha==$past(i_cpha)). Changes are then allowed only in cycles with o_cs_n=1, including the cycle ending at the burst-start edge (spec:428). This rule is in the spec (spec:448), but it removes formal coverage of REQ-MODE-003/REQ-ERR-001, which would then rely on simulation test CHK-033 or a separate formal run without ENV-003. Doing both is consistent.

spec_says: spec:248 [REQ-MOSI-002] "With CPHA_b = 0, `o_mosi` shall take the value d[7] at the acceptance edge A."; spec:260 "With CPHA_b = 0, `o_mosi` keeps d[0] after SCLK edge 16 unless the next command is accepted at that edge, in which case it takes the next d[7] at that edge"; spec:57 CPHA_b is captured at the first acceptance edge of the burst; spec:209-211 REQ-MODE-002/003; spec:400 REQ-ERR-001; spec:97 and spec:448 ENV-003 (i_cpha may change only while o_cs_n=1). contract.json:1071 says CPHA_b is captured only at a burst start.

(2) E: add an ENV-003 assumption to nnc_env.sv (if !o_cs_n, i_cpol and i_cpha equal their previous-cycle values). This rule is in the spec, but REQ-ERR-001 would then lose formal coverage.

spec_says: spec:252 [REQ-MOSI-004] "With CPHA_b = 1, `o_mosi` shall take the value d[7 − j] at edge A + (2·j + 1)·D for j = 0 to 7 (SCLK edges 1, 3, …, 15)."; spec:260 with CPHA_b=1 o_mosi holds from the acceptance edge until SCLK edge 1; spec:215 [REQ-MODE-005] with CPHA_b=1 the leading edges are shift edges; spec:57 CPHA_b definition; spec:211 REQ-MODE-003; spec:400 REQ-ERR-001; spec:448 ENV-003. contract.json:397 (CHK-014) uses CPHA_b.
verification_does: nnc_chk_mosi.sv:54 sets ph_r <= i_cpha (0) at the continuation handshake. Line 79: smp0 = busy && !ph_r && (cn1 % 2D == D) marks A+D as a sampling edge. Line 83: exp_s = d_r[7-js0] = d[7]. Lines 103-104 require o_mosi to be stable across that edge and equal to d[7]. Under CPHA_b=1, that edge is a shift edge.

spec_says: spec:232 [REQ-SCLK-003] "While `o_cs_n` = 0 and no transfer is between its SCLK edges 1 and 16, `o_sclk` shall equal CPOL_b. This covers the lead half period, Pause and Trail."; spec:57 CPOL_b definition; spec:209 REQ-MODE-002 (SPI-7.3-02, listed for CHK-025 at contract.json:587); spec:211 REQ-MODE-003; spec:400 REQ-ERR-001; spec:96 and spec:448 ENV-003. contract.json:620 (CHK-027) says o_sclk toggles to CPOL_b at A_p+16*D. contract.json:1071 says CPOL_b is captured only at a burst start.
verification_does: nnc_chk_sclk.sv:57 sets t_cpol_b <= i_cpol on every hs_cmd, including the continuation handshake at col 18 with o_cs_n=0. Line 79 then requires o_sclk == t_cpol_b in the lead cycles (t_cnt < D_CYC).

This fixes CHK-023/025/027, which share t_cpol_b. (2) E: add the ENV-003 assumption on i_cpol/i_cpha to nnc_env.sv (stable while o_cs_n=0).
